question: Which of the following terms describes the common point of a tangent to a circle and the circle itself?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Tangent touches circle at only one point

⇒ That common point is called Point of Contact

**∴ Answer = Point of Tangency**
